goal: Group world modeling in one Python package and give motion, controllers, benchmarks, and demos explicit homes.

hierarchy.pyproject.toml: Declare Python dependencies and package discovery at the repository root.

world_model/.build_scene.py: Compose the imported robot and workspace into MuJoCo scene.xml.
world_model/.scene_config.json: Shared workspace dimensions and object placement for MuJoCo and the HTML viewer.
world_model/.actuators.py: Define servo settings and generate the MuJoCo actuator XML shared by both pour scenarios.
world_model/.water.py: Model water discharge, flight, collection, spill, and changing load.
world_model/.paths.py: Resolve the shared scene configuration and simulation output paths.
world_model/.collision.py: Query MuJoCo contacts between the robot and the workspace.

motion/.pour_motion.py: Convert target bottle poses into timed joint references using inverse kinematics and clearance checks.

benchmarks/.pose.py: Provide the shared robot pose for scenario setup and scene export.
benchmarks/.setup_pour_pose.py: Configure the held bottle, parked joints, and reset keyframes for attached-bottle and free-grasp scenes.

demos/.demo_pour_water.py: Coupled robot motion and water transfer demo.

simulation/.export_scene.py: Export the robot model and static views for layout review.
simulation/.viewer/: Three.js viewer source, offline HTML builder, and npm dependencies.
simulation/.reconstruction/: Exported robot GLB and reference views.
simulation/.generated/: Local MuJoCo XML, previews, and demo GIFs.

package_management.python: Use an editable install in the project virtual environment and package imports throughout.
package_management.javascript: Keep npm dependencies and the lockfile in simulation/viewer/.

migration: Move existing modules into their proposed packages and update imports and asset paths.
Move the shared pose helper out of export_scene.py and into benchmarks for use by scene export and benchmark setup.
Update the viewer build to read scene_config.json from world_model.
Verify scene generation, both pour reset variants, HTML export, and the existing demos through their new entry points.
